# Frontend stop/restart dry test, Phase 2, 2026-11-16 (device ANBERNIC)
# Unit: launcher.service (sysv-generated from /etc/init.d/launcher.sh).
# Chain: launcher.service -> launcher.sh -> loadapp.sh -> dmenu_ln -> dmenu.bin.
# NOTE: pidof does NOT see shell scripts (comm=bash); use ps/pgrep -f for them.

===== unit definition
$ systemctl cat launcher.service | head -20
# /run/systemd/generator.late/launcher.service
# Automatically generated by systemd-sysv-generator
[Unit]
Documentation=man:systemd-sysv-generator(8)
SourcePath=/etc/init.d/launcher.sh
Before=graphical.target
[Service]
Type=forking
Restart=no
TimeoutSec=5min
IgnoreSIGPIPE=no
KillMode=process
GuessMainPID=no
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/etc/init.d/launcher.sh start
ExecStop=/etc/init.d/launcher.sh stop

$ systemctl show launcher.service -p Names,Type,Restart,ExecStart,ExecStop
Type=forking / Restart=no / Names=launcher.service
ExecStart=/etc/init.d/launcher.sh start / ExecStop=/etc/init.d/launcher.sh stop

===== stop path (launcher.sh, verbatim case branch)
  stop|restart)
		killall retroarch
		killall rtk_hciattach
		killall loadapp.sh
		killall -s SIGINT dmenu.bin
		killall -s SIGUSR1 dmenu.bin
		killall -s SIGUSR1 muos.bin
		killall -s SIGINT charg.dge
		killall -s SIGINT ndsCtrl.dge
		printf "stop deeplay_launcher"
		sync
        ;;

===== pre-stop tree
root  2131  1    /bin/bash /etc/init.d/launcher.sh start
root  2132  2131 /bin/bash /mnt/vendor/ctrl/loadapp.sh
root  2433  2132 /bin/bash /mnt/vendor/ctrl/dmenu_ln
root  2434  2433 /mnt/vendor/bin/dmenu.bin   (53% CPU)

===== BASELINE (dmenu 2434 running)
boot_mode=0 ; no /mnt/mmc/gpio_keys_polled.ko ; no /mnt/mod/.last
fuser: /dev/snd/pcmC0D0p: root 2434 F.... dmenu.bin
card0 Subdevices: 0/1 ; uptime 2508.57 ; dmesg suspend-entry count 2

===== STOP
$ date +%s.%N; time sudo -n systemctl stop launcher.service; ...
1794832546.752681505
stop-exit=0
real	0m0.249s
1794832547.010051069
inactive            # systemctl is-active
dmenu pid: 2434     # <-- STILL ALIVE right after stop-exit=0
loadapp pid:        # respawn loop DEAD immediately (killall loadapp.sh)
fuser: /dev/snd/pcmC0D0p: root 2434 F.... dmenu.bin   # ALSA still held
card0 Subdevices: 0/1

===== DMENU LINGER (found ~45 s later, next command)
$ ps -o pid,stat,wchan:25,etime,comm -p 2434; sudo -n kill -TERM 2434; ...
    PID STAT WCHAN  ELAPSED COMMAND     # <- no row: already gone
kill: (2434): No such process           # <- TERM never delivered; nothing to kill
DMENU_GONE_AFTER_TERM
fuser: (no output — no holders)
card 0 Subdevices: 1/1                  # ALSA FREE
=> SIGINT/SIGUSR1 from the stop path DID kill dmenu, but shutdown is SLOW
   (alive at +0.3 s, gone by ~+45 s). No SIGKILL was ever needed.
   PROCEDURE: after `systemctl stop`, poll `pidof dmenu.bin` up to 60 s
   before assuming ALSA is free.

===== SETTLE 25 s (stopped checkpoint)
inactive ; dmenu: (none) ; loadapp: (none) ; card0 1/1 ; SSH_ALIVE
=> Restart=no + dead loop = zero respawn. SSH unaffected by frontend stop.

===== START
$ ... time sudo -n systemctl start launcher.service; ...
1794832606.733366787
start-exit=0
real	0m0.099s
1794832606.836130431
active
=> start returns in 0.1 s (loadapp runs async in background subshell).
   No SSH stall: NetworkManager restart inside loadapp kept the wlan0 link.

===== RETURN (polled every 5 s)
dmenu back after ~5s pid=10506
root  10392 ... /bin/bash /mnt/vendor/ctrl/loadapp.sh     # fresh loop
root  10506 ... /mnt/vendor/bin/dmenu.bin                 # fresh frontend
fuser: /dev/snd/pcmC0D0p: root 10506 F.... dmenu.bin      # ALSA re-held
card0 Subdevices: 0/1 ; launcher.service active
disp layer back: ch[1] lyr[0] 640x480 @ff000000 ff04b000 ff096000,
fps 59.5, backlight 140 (same config as pre-stop).
dmesg suspend-entry count still 1-of-ring (ring wrap only; no suspend
occurred during the test — and none was expected: idle timer dormant,
see hw-phase2.md sleep section).

===== restore steps (all reversible, nothing persisted)
stop : sudo systemctl stop launcher.service && poll pidof dmenu.bin (<=60 s)
start: sudo systemctl start launcher.service && poll pidof dmenu.bin (<=30 s)
stuck: sudo kill -TERM <dmenu pid>; last resort sudo kill -KILL <pid>
never: kill dmenu without stopping the service (loop respawns instantly);
       start a 2nd dmenu while the old one lives (fb/ALSA fight).
